scope: Fresh-server setup guide and minimal setup-tool corrections; no deployment
changes: SETUP.md is the single complete fresh-install procedure, from tools/clone through DB/IdP, first accounts, HTTPS, core/worker, portal/frame runtime, systemd, native CLI and first dev app.
Public-domain certificate and single-IP/private-CA branches; disclose that deployed app SDK private-CA trust propagation is not implemented.
Source-built native CLI is independent from optional aggregate publication. Pin server and CLI binaries to separate paths.
Replace incomplete duplicate setup commands and unreachable public Keycloak admin-UI instructions in current documentation.
Normalize up.sh state paths before bootstrap/build/services; reject an empty --state-dir=.
PostgreSQL/Keycloak restart unless explicitly stopped; PostgreSQL health waits for TCP after first initialization.

checks.scope: All configured script checks, including 8 mocked up.sh cases and 14 existing isolated server/proxy check groups. Expanded Compose checks verify restart policies and TCP readiness without printing fixture secrets.
Actual extracted guide commands, temporary state and generated keys only; getpass mocked; no daemon/network/trust-store changes.
Extracted employee provisioning snippet; mocked HTTP and terminal/input; UUID-only output, loopback/no-proxy/no-redirect, invalid-input and HTTP failure cases.
Syntax, relative links/anchors and version lookup from selected source commit; no installation commands executed.
Tracked-document links including incoming SETUP links. New SETUP outgoing links checked separately.

preservedFailures.cause: pathlib.Path.open does not accept opener; TypeError before saving passwords.
preservedFailures.resolution: Use built-in open with mode 0600 opener. Both address branches and 12 rejection/atomicity cases passed after correction.

preservedFailures.cause: input() reads exhausted stdin after python3 here-document; EOFError before the HTTP call.
preservedFailures.resolution: Explicit /dev/tty input with non-TTY rejection; 16 fixture cases passed.

preservedFailures.stage: Old up.sh negative-control result classifier (verification harness)
preservedFailures.cause: Initial classifier assumed all four relative-path cases fail by missing frame output; one instead fails while reading settings through a missing intermediate path.
preservedFailures.resolution: Classified the baseline failures as three missing-frame cases and one settings-read failure. This was a harness assertion, not a failure of the corrected up.sh.

reviewCorrections: Read version from crates/miy/Cargo.toml at the server installation commit, not missing workspace.package or an unrelated work-PC HEAD.
Wait for Keycloak before configure-identity and public issuer before Core; check all three health endpoints before is-active.
New employee accounts use loopback identity administration; public /identity/admin and master realm remain blocked.
Default app acceptance covers ping, DB connection/migration and installation state, not business-record CRUD/backup.
Nginx port-range rendering does not require 1.28-specific syntax; target-host nginx -t remains required.
